name: Supply Chain Risk Assessment
description: Assesses and tracks supply chain risk for tools, MCP servers, and third-party dependencies used by agents. Evaluates trust relationships, monitors dependency health, and identifies supply chain compromise indicators.
threat_addressed: Agents depend on external tools and MCP servers with their own dependency trees, vulnerabilities, and maintainer risks. A compromised or poorly maintained tool in the agent's supply chain can introduce vulnerabilities that bypass the agent's own security controls.
enforcement_mechanism: Risk assessment per registered tool covering provenance verification, SBOM analysis, vulnerability status, maintainer reputation, dependency trees, and update frequency. Critical vulnerabilities in approved tools trigger remediation or removal.

security_outcome.pass: Assessment completed for all registered tools. SBOMs available. No unresolved critical vulnerabilities in approved tools.
security_outcome.fail: Supply chain risk not assessed or exceeds defined tolerance.

display_detail: Assesses supply chain risk for tools, MCP servers, and third-party dependencies.
remediation_hint_template: Supply chain risk assessment incomplete. Register and assess all tool dependencies used by this agent.
